status: PROTOCOL FROZEN — corpus not yet frozen
study_type: preregistered measurement of the shipped OCR routing gate on a stratified natural corpus
experimental_unit: one natural open-licence PDF read once through the shipped local reader path with ocr_client=None
primary_metric: routing recall and false-negative count on natural held-out documents labelled needs_ocr

measured_policy.description: the packaged policy exactly as shipped; nothing is replayed or reimplemented
measured_policy.basis: ADR-065 (packaged gate), ADR-066 (reader fallback chain), TDR-024 (evidence correction)

strata.born_digital: PDF produced from a digital source; expected to stay on the fast path
strata.mixed: mostly born-digital PDF containing some scanned or image-only pages
strata.image_only_scan: scanned or image PDF with no text layer
strata.scan_with_text_layer: scanned PDF carrying an existing OCR text layer (faithful or junk)
strata.reader_failure: usable text layer that pdf-inspector extracts as empty (TDR-024 Type A GlyphLessFont or Type B WinAnsi without /ToUnicode)
strata.stratum_role: a stratum is assigned from provenance at sourcing; routing correctness is judged against the independent label, never against the stratum

corpus_rules.unrecoverable_target: at least 3 unrecoverable pages or documents across the corpus
corpus_rules.licence_note: non-commercial licences follow the Experiment 31 precedent; PDFs are never committed (experiments/**/*.pdf is gitignored)
corpus_rules.sourcing_log: sources.json (committed) and SOURCING.md (committed, generated from sources.json)
corpus_rules.sourcing_log_location_deviation: tasks.md 2.8 names corpus/SOURCING.md, but experiments/**/corpus/ is gitignored; the log lives at the experiment root so it is committed
corpus_rules.selection_independence: pdf-inspector MUST NOT be run on candidates for born_digital, mixed, image_only_scan or scan_with_text_layer before the Stage A run; selection uses provenance, poppler and the labelling tooling only
corpus_rules.reader_failure_selection_disclosure: reader_failure candidates are selected by raw pdf_inspector.process_pdf returning text_based with empty markdown, as in Experiment 31; this is inherent to the stratum definition
corpus_rules.development_exclusions: dev_exclusions.json — every SHA-256 from Experiments 29, 30 and 31; a candidate matching any digest is rejected from held-out
corpus_rules.split: every accepted natural document is held_out; synthetic documents are a separate stratum and never held_out

labels.status: RULE FROZEN — labels not yet produced
labels.rendering: poppler pdftoppm, 150 dpi, scaled to 1600 px long side, PNG
labels.text_layer_independence: pdf-inspector is never a label extractor; pypdf is also fallback tier 2 of the measured path, which is disclosed — a text layer that any independent extractor reads is a usable text layer

reference_transcription.model: google/gemini-3.8-flash (pinned in label_pages.py; response model id recorded per page)
reference_transcription.failed_call: three attempts; still failing -> page is ambiguous with label_error recorded
reference_transcription.prompt_rule: transcribe readable text verbatim in the original script; mathematical notation as plain Unicode characters, never LaTeX

labels.token_rule: NFKC, lowercase, remove LaTeX command sequences (backslash followed by letters), split on non-word characters and underscores, drop tokens shorter than 2 characters
labels.match_score: R = multiset token recall of the text layer against the reference transcription; R_best = max over the two extractors
page_rule: reference has fewer than 10 tokens -> usable (no_text)
document_rule: unrecoverable pages >= 50% of pages -> document unrecoverable
labels.tolerance_basis: the 10% missing-page tolerance approved in the Experiment 29 decision register; it equals the gate threshold by operator judgement, and it is disclosed
labels.character_count_rule: character count alone never decides a label
labels.spot_check: operator reviews every unrecoverable page, every page in an ambiguous document, and a seeded (seed 33) 10% random sample of the remaining pages against the rendered image; agreement is recorded in spot_check.json
labels.freeze_condition: labels are frozen only when operator disagreement on the random sample is at most 10%; above that, the page rule is revised and the spot check repeated — allowed because no routing output exists yet

body_text_amendment.label: page and document label decided by BODY text: running text, headings, captions, footnotes, table cells, headers and footers
body_text_amendment.label_all_text: the original all-visible-text label, kept for a page-level routing arm
body_text_amendment.figure_text: text inside figures, charts, diagrams, drawings, photographs, stamps and signatures; measured apart as figure_tokens_missing, never decides label
body_text_amendment.split_pass: second OpenRouter pass (same pinned model, SPLIT_PROMPT in label_pages.py) on every page whose all-text label is needs_ocr or ambiguous; pages labelled usable or unrecoverable keep one label for both

stages.A: routing only, ocr_client=None, no OCR worker, no model load, no network
stages.B: real OCR — NOT authorised; requires a separate decision-register entry naming subset, timeout and runtime budget

ocr_authorisation.note: Stage A only. OCR cost is reported as a projection; recovery quality is unmeasured.

measurements.population: natural held-out documents whose document label is needs_ocr or usable

primary.routing_recall: routed needs_ocr documents / needs_ocr documents, with a Wilson 95% interval
primary.false_negative_detail: per false negative: stratum, pdf_type, confidence, pages_needing_ocr, needs_ocr page count (evidence at risk)

secondary.unnecessary_ocr_pages: pages labelled usable in routed documents
secondary.projected_ocr_seconds: routed pages x 33.7 s (best) and x 106.4 s (worst) — PROJECTION (ocr-worker/SMOKE_RESULTS.md)
secondary.ambiguous_sensitivity: primary counts recomputed with ambiguous documents as needs_ocr and as usable
secondary.unrecoverable_routes: routing decision per unrecoverable document, outside every denominator
secondary.reader_quality_loss: fast-path documents whose extracted-text token recall against the reference transcription of legible pages is below 0.80; attributed to extraction_fallback_backend when set, else to pdf_inspector; never counted as an OCR false negative

monitored: content-type detection label and detector path

decision_rule.incomplete: zero natural held-out needs_ocr documents -> held-out recall is NOT claimed; result INCOMPLETE for the primary safety question
decision_rule.false_negative_trigger: false_negative_count >= 1 -> report as a material finding and recommend a separate calibration proposal
decision_rule.false_positive_trigger: false_positive_count >= 1 on born_digital -> report as a material finding and recommend a separate calibration proposal
decision_rule.thresholds: 0.5 and 0.10 are never changed by this experiment

amendments.stage: before any label or routing output; after a 20-page cost probe
amendments.change: reference model pinned to google/gemini-3.8-flash; max_output_tokens 4096 -> 8192 (dense patent and newspaper pages); prompt asks for plain-Unicode mathematics; token rule strips LaTeX command sequences and splits on underscores; page rule order corrected so a failed or truncated call is ambiguous before the no-text rule (a failed call has zero reference tokens and would otherwise be labelled usable)
amendments.reason: the probe scored a born-digital arXiv page (bd07 p34) at R_best 0.45 because the reference transcription wrote mathematics as LaTeX (\mathcal, \frac, i_m), which no text layer contains; left unfixed, born-digital mathematics pages would be mislabelled needs_ocr
amendments.disclosure: the 20 probe transcripts were discarded and regenerated under the amended prompt; the probe cost ($0.06) is reported

amendments.stage: before any natural routing output; after the synthetic boundary probe (task 5.4)
amendments.change: Stage A measures two arms: sampled_baseline (preregistered gate at 5bac71e) and full_scan_candidate (change full-page-ocr-evidence at 7280766). Measurements, labels, corpus and decision rule are unchanged and applied to each arm.
amendments.reason: the probe showed pdf-inspector counts OCR pages from an 8-page sample, so scanned pages outside the sample never reach the gate; the candidate fix also flags illustration pages in healthy books (TDR-026), so its merge waits for both effects measured on natural documents

amendments.stage: after labels were produced, before any spot-check verdict, label freeze or natural routing output
amendments.change: labels use body text; all-visible-text labels kept as label_all_text; figure text measured apart; spot check regenerated to judge body text
amendments.reason: the all-text rule labelled born-digital pages with charts and patent drawing sheets needs_ocr (bd02 p5-p6, tl06-tl08 p1), so whole-document routing would be scored against chart labels it cannot cheaply recover

decision_register.consequence: real physical scan artefacts (page curl, uneven lighting, bleed-through, paper texture) are not tested; the report states this limit

decision_register.scope: synthetic documents only, run through the Stage A harness, reported as exploratory; never held-out evidence; thresholds unchanged

decision_register.subset: natural pages whose frozen body label or all-text label is needs_ocr
decision_register.engine: pdf-inspector 1.17.0 process_pdf_with_ocr, mode force, PP-OCRv6 Small on ONNX Runtime, CPU, local only
decision_register.timeout: 900 s soft limit per document (flagged, not killed)
decision_register.purpose: evidence gate 1 for OpenSpec change page-level-ocr-routing; PaddleOCR-VL Stage B stays unauthorised

sampled_baseline.description: the gate as preregistered: pdf-inspector OCR evidence from its 8-page detection sample

full_scan_candidate.description: change full-page-ocr-evidence (TDR-026): text_based PDFs over 8 pages count OCR pages from a full page scan; not merged, decision waits for this comparison

arms.execution: each arm runs route.py from this worktree with --code-root pointing at a detached worktree of the arm commit (git worktree add --detach); same frozen corpus, labels and scoring; outputs in output/arm_<name>/
arms.reporting: every primary and secondary measurement is reported per arm; arm_divergence lists documents whose route differs, with their labels
